# Native call inventory and counterpart boundary

Native function bodies and direct call targets reopened from shipped ELF; names resolved through ARM PLT/GOT. This census includes full enclosing functions (and hence neighboring unchanged operations), not only changed call instructions. It is review data, not a settlement verdict. Every row-built engine log, file read, counter and static is described in the per-record rows/diff. Calls with missing owned recipients are marked below. Runtime string/container allocation maps to managed storage; behavioral ownership gaps are separately marked MISSING.
